“Having established mindfulness,
the bhikkhunī with developed faculties penetrated the state of peace.”
“The happiness that is the subsiding of conditioned formations.
“For whose sake have you shaved your head?
You appear like a female ascetic;”
"You do not approve of the sects;
why then do you wander about so bewildered?
"The sects are outside of this [path];"
Relying upon views,
they do not understand the Dhamma;
they are not skilled in the Dhamma.
There is one born in the Sakya clan,
a Buddha, a peerless person;
he taught the Dhamma to me.
The transcendence of views;
suffering, the arising of suffering,
and the overcoming of suffering.
And the Noble Eightfold Path,
which leads to the cessation of suffering.
Having heard his words, I—
Dwelling delighted in the Teaching,
I have attained the threefold knowledge and fulfilled the Buddha’s instruction.
Delight is destroyed everywhere,
the mass of darkness is shattered;
know this, O Evil One!
“You are slain, O Antaka!
… Thus spoke the elder nun Cālā.
